description: Changes one stored text field of a webinar: the host name, the description, the sales copy, the main headline, the thank-you headline or its sub-headline. Take it when a whole field should be replaced. A host says: "My description is out of date, here is the new one." It needs the session, the webinar, the field and the new value. It writes on your site, and the value stands on the pages and in the emails that use it from the next load on. No text is generated and nothing else changes. To change one wording inside a longer text this is the wrong place; that one is wi_change_webinar_text. The host name cannot be emptied, the site refuses that with a plain reason. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: change the description, new headline, sales copy, host name

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

field.description: Which stored text to replace. One field per call.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

value.description: The new text, verbatim from the host. Never shortened and never invented.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_settings
title: Change one stored text of a webinar
